notes: Canonical first playable implementation, originally prepared as Observation 006 and renumbered to Observation 009 during archive integration after slot 006 was occupied. A space mining incremental clicker for the Clicker Management Hall with click-to-mine, drone automation, upgrade progression across four tiers, five resource types unlocked via prestige, and canvas-based visual feedback including particles, orbiting drones, and floating damage numbers. The model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry; gameplay and economy were not changed by the renumbering. Publishing completed missing page-shell layout CSS so the original interface renders correctly.
